name: Mark Palmer
description: Mark Palmer of the University of Missouri contributed a PLACE19 session on Indigenous place names, stories and interpretive attributes in World Heritage maps. His abstract proposes a conceptual story-mapping model and distinguishes meaningful cultural representation from static labels.
